name: shared-check-changes-engineering-16
objective:
Implement one nonpublishing check_changes operation in the existing application-level coding-command Tool owner. Existing CodingCommands/run_check supplies fixed Git and validation operations through ToolRunner; WorkCycle reuses validation for independently reviewed closeout. Extend this composition instead of creating another executor, validation engine or framework dependency on apps. Native command_definitions and COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES must expose check_changes with empty object arguments only. Calling CodingCommands.dispatch or ToolRunner.execute(tool, ("check_changes", {})) returns a JSON-serializable deterministic report with operation, status, ready_for_review, changed (path collection), source_sha256 (all authorized source paths including absent new slots as null), checks (per-name status/exit/diagnostic fields), and relative evidence reference. Add is_current(report) on that same Tool to safely recheck the bound candidate/plan after return, not reuse stale success. Use the existing path, source-hash, managed Git, fixed run_check and evidence mechanisms. No model-selected commands, paths, tests or effects; no source edits or Git mutation from this operation. Shared means the same ToolRunner contract may be called by Qwen or a trusted Codex supervisor, not a separate Codex executor.
Bound inspection to the host task's exact source/test/read resources and authorized new slots. Unrelated preexisting files outside this scope are not a claim of whole-checkout cleanliness. Identify actual current tracked changes versus HEAD and authorized untracked/new files. Changes to task resources outside editable sources, missing existing source, unsupported deletion, unsafe paths, missing Git/plan/resources, or changed source/validation inputs during checking must refuse readiness. Use exact current existing hash semantics, Git HEAD/status and required test/read/host-runner identities before/after; do not create another repository-version authority. A report applies only to that state. is_current must detect later source, Git or plan drift and must not read arbitrary paths from untrusted report data. No caching of an earlier success after edits.
Use the existing five fixed checks (tests, oracle, ruff, format, typing), their host-owned selection and managed execution. Do not infer tests from filenames. A complete review plan requires task tests/oracle, quality_checks and command_tools; unavailable/incomplete plans cannot pass. Return independent checks with statuses PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE/INTERRUPTED as applicable. Overall PASS and ready_for_review=true only if all five checks pass and integrity stays current; genuine nonzero diagnostics give FAIL/false, invalid or unavailable state gives BLOCKED/false. No candidate changes gives NO_CHANGES/false and explicitly nonexecuted checks. Continue independent check reporting after ordinary failures; do not erase passing statuses. Preserve full returned logs in the existing coding-command evidence, bound each model-visible stdout/stderr to at most3000characters with explicit truncation. Cancellation must archive INTERRUPTED nonpassing evidence and propagate host cancellation, not silently claim failure rollback or success. Preserve historical run_check/git_inspect behavior and native receipts. Do not turn this into publication authority or alter closeout/review.
Investigate existing owners and source invariants before editing; briefly distinguish existing observations, remaining obligations and common pre-transaction anchors. Qwen authors all semantic check_changes changes. Do not change task, tests or oracle. Frozen behavioral, existing regression, Ruff, formatting and strict typing acceptance all apply. No solution or host-only reference is provided.

import asyncio, hashlib, json, sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
from apps.qwen import commands
from apps.qwen.coding_loop import _prepare_workspace
from apps.qwen.development_task import _hash, _timed_command
from apps.qwen.tasks import CodingTask
from devtools.models.interaction import ModelToolCall
from devtools.tools import ToolRunner

GOOD='"""Authored validation fixture."""\n\nVALUE: int = 2\n'
BASE=GOOD.replace('= 2','= 1')
SOURCE='src/devtools/demo.py'; NEW='src/devtools/new_module.py'; TEST='tests/test_demo.py'; READ='src/devtools/read_only.py'
CHECKS=('tests','oracle','ruff','format','typing')
async def command(root,*args):
    r=await _timed_command(root,*args)
    assert not r['failed'],r
    return r
async def fixture(root):
    for p,t in {SOURCE:BASE,READ:'VALUE = 0\n',TEST:'import runpy\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ndef test_value():\n    assert runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).parents[1]/"src/devtools/demo.py"))["VALUE"] == 2\n','src/devtools/__init__.py':'','.gitignore':'.local/\n','pyproject.toml':'[tool.ruff.lint]\nselect=["F"]\n'}.items():
        path=root/p;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_text(t,encoding='utf-8')
    await command(root,'git','init','-q')
    await command(root,'git','-c','user.name=Fixture','-c','user.email=fixture@invalid','add','.')
    await command(root,'git','-c','user.name=Fixture','-c','user.email=fixture@invalid','commit','-qm','Authored baseline')
    base=(await command(root,'git','rev-parse','HEAD'))['stdout'].strip()
    paths=(SOURCE,TEST,READ)
    task=CodingTask(name='qualified-check-changes-fixture',objective='Validate authored bounded candidate',source=SOURCE,tests=(TEST,),baseline_revision=base,baseline_hashes=tuple((p,_hash(root/p)) for p in paths),context=tuple((p,'VALUE','mixed','file') for p in paths),oracle='assert module.VALUE == 2\n',read_paths=(READ,),context_mode='on-demand',quality_checks=True,command_tools=True,path_edits=True,new_paths=(NEW,))
    folder=root/'.local/checks';folder.mkdir(parents=True);_prepare_workspace(root,folder,task)
    return task,folder
async def invoke(tool):
    r=await tool.dispatch(ModelToolCall('check_changes','{}','qualified-native-call'))
    assert r['operation']=='check_changes'
    assert set(CHECKS)<=set(r['checks']),r
    assert type(r['ready_for_review']) is bool
    assert r['source_sha256'][SOURCE]==_hash(tool.root/SOURCE) or not r['ready_for_review']
    evidence=tool.folder/r['evidence'];assert evidence.is_file(),'Full authoritative report must be archived'
    json.loads(evidence.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for v in r['checks'].values():
        assert v['status'] in {'PASS','FAIL','BLOCKED','UNAVAILABLE','NOT_APPLICABLE','INTERRUPTED'}
        assert len(v.get('stdout',''))<=3000 and len(v.get('stderr',''))<=3000
    return r
def fake_result(check,failed=False,text=''):
    return {'argv':('fixed',check),'exit_code':1 if failed else 0,'failed':failed,'stdout':text,'stderr':'','elapsed_seconds':0.0}
async def qualify_fixtures():
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-check16-') as temp:
        root=Path(temp).resolve();task,folder=await fixture(root)
        failure=await commands.run_check(root,folder,task,'tests');assert failure['failed'] and 'assert 1 == 2' in failure['stdout'],failure
        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD,encoding='utf-8')
        for check in CHECKS: await assert_check(root,folder,task,check)
        stable=_hash(root/SOURCE);runner=folder/'tests-runner.py';plan=_hash(runner)
        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD+'\n# independently qualified drift\n',encoding='utf-8')
        assert _hash(root/SOURCE)!=stable
        status=await command(root,'git','status','--porcelain','--',SOURCE)
        assert SOURCE in status['stdout']
        runner.write_text(runner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')+'\n# plan drift\n',encoding='utf-8')
        assert _hash(runner)!=plan

        assert lint['failed'] and 'F401' in lint['stdout']
        assert typing['failed'] and 'import-not-found' in typing['stdout']
        print('QUALIFIED: real pytest intended baseline failure; all five positive checks; real Ruff and typing negative fixtures')
async def assert_check(root,folder,task,check):
    r=await commands.run_check(root,folder,task,check);assert not r['failed'],(check,r)
async def run_checks():
    assert 'check_changes' in commands.COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES,'Missing composed check_changes native operation'
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-check16-') as temp:
        root=Path(temp).resolve();task,folder=await fixture(root);tool=commands.CodingCommands(root,folder,task)
        definition=next(x for x in commands.command_definitions(task) if x.name=='check_changes')

        try: tool.validate(('check_changes',{'paths':['../outside.py']}))

        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD,encoding='utf-8');(root/NEW).write_text('"""Authorized new fixture."""\n',encoding='utf-8')

        assert {SOURCE,NEW}==set(r['changed']),r['changed']

        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD+'\n# after result\n',encoding='utf-8');assert not tool.is_current(r),'Old success cannot apply to new source'
        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD,encoding='utf-8')
        # Real diagnostics must reach the agent through the same native Tool boundary.

        r=await invoke(tool);assert r['status']=='FAIL' and not r['ready_for_review'],r
        assert r['checks']['ruff']['status']=='FAIL' and 'F401' in r['checks']['ruff'].get('stdout','')
        assert r['checks']['typing']['status']=='FAIL'
        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD,encoding='utf-8')

        # Long command output remains archived, with bounded model-visible diagnostics.
        async def long_failure(a,b,c,check):return fake_result(check,check=='ruff','X'*12000 if check=='ruff' else 'ok')

        assert r['status']=='FAIL' and len(r['checks']['ruff'].get('stdout',''))<=3000
        assert 'X'*12000 in (folder/r['evidence']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'Do not lose complete returned output'
        # A supported unavailable plan must never become a passing test.
        runner=folder/'tests-runner.py';saved=runner.read_bytes();runner.unlink()
        r=await invoke(tool);assert not r['ready_for_review'] and r['checks']['tests']['status'] in {'FAIL','BLOCKED','UNAVAILABLE'},r
        runner.write_bytes(saved)
        async def mutate(a,b,c,check):
            if check=='tests': (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD+'\n# during check\n',encoding='utf-8')
            return fake_result(check)
        with patch.object(commands,'run_check',mutate):r=await invoke(tool)
        assert r['status']=='BLOCKED' and not r['ready_for_review'],r
        (root/SOURCE).write_text(GOOD,encoding='utf-8')
        async def change_runner(a,b,c,check):
            if check=='tests':runner.write_text('# altered plan\n',encoding='utf-8')
            return fake_result(check)
        with patch.object(commands,'run_check',change_runner):r=await invoke(tool)
        assert r['status']=='BLOCKED' and not r['ready_for_review'],'Validation plan drift must invalidate results'
        runner.write_bytes(saved)
        async def unavailable(a,b,c,check):
            if check=='tests':raise OSError('Qualified unavailable check')
            return fake_result(check)
        with patch.object(commands,'run_check',unavailable):r=await invoke(tool)
        assert r['status']=='BLOCKED' and not r['ready_for_review'],r
        # Cancellation propagates while preserving an inspectable nonpassing report.
        async def cancelled(a,b,c,check):raise asyncio.CancelledError('Qualified interruption')
        with patch.object(commands,'run_check',cancelled):
            try:await invoke(tool)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('Do not swallow host cancellation')
        assert any('INTERRUPTED' in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in folder.glob('coding-command-*.json')),'Interrupted operation must retain evidence'
        incomplete=commands.CodingCommands(root,folder,replace(task,quality_checks=False))
        r=await invoke(incomplete);assert not r['ready_for_review'],'Incomplete quality plan is not full pre-review validation'
        print('PASS: native ToolRunner composition, real Git/tracked/new changes, five real checks, bounded/full diagnostics, scope refusal, no mutation, source/runner drift, unavailable plans, cancellation and freshness')
if __name__=='__main__':asyncio.run(run_checks())
